title: Patriots owner Robert Kraft pledges $2 million to Palestinian region at Ed Sheeran's request

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots owner Robert Kraft pledges $2 million to Palestinian region at Ed Sheeran's request
sources.description: Patriots owner Robert Kraft, who was a part of Macklemore's removal from Ed Sheeran’s tour, announced a $2 million donation to the Palestinian region.
